```plato

    // Linear interpolation; t is unclamped, so 0 yields a, 1 yields b, and values
    // outside [0, 1] extrapolate.
    Lerp(a: Number, b: Number, t: Number): Number
        => a + (b - a) * t;
```

## Line 56

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/primitives.library.plato, line 56](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/primitives.library.plato#L56).

```plato

    // Linear interpolation carried out in Number and truncated back to Integer,
    // so the result steps rather than rounding to nearest. t is unclamped.
    Lerp(a: Integer, b: Integer, t: Number): Integer
        => (a.ToNumber + (b.ToNumber - a.ToNumber) * t).ToInteger;
```
